description_en: Submits a job of deleting media files from a media fingerprint library
name: SubmitFpFileDeleteJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue to which the job is submitted. The MPS queue is bound with a notification method. To view the MPS queue ID, log on to the MPS console and choose Global Settings > MPS queue and Callback in the left-side navigation pane
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，用于绑定消息通知，可以通过MPS控制台 > 全局设置 > 管道获取
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media fingerprint library. You can obtain the library ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DNA库ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: fp_db_id

parameters.help_en: The custom data. The value can contain letters and digits and can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，支持中英文、数字等，最大长度128个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the media files that you want to delete. Separate multiple file IDs with commas (,). You can delete up to 200 media files at a time. You can obtain media file IDs from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209266.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的文件ID，用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多删除200个。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209266.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en:
The primary keys of the files to be deleted. Separate multiple primary keys with commas (,). You can delete up to 200 primary keys at a time. You can obtain the primary keys of media files from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209266.html operation.

This parameter is available only in the China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shanghai) regions
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的文件PrimaryKey，用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多删除200个。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209266.html的返回参数中获取。

此参数当前仅支持华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海）地域使用
parameters.name: primary_keys
